::: {.callout-note}
Detailed programme to follow.
:::

A day of invited talks, open to all. Each method talk is followed by a case study that applies or
tests such a method. The talks are grouped in two sessions:

- Detecting shifts and measuring resilience
- Mechanisms and anticipation

The day ends with a panel discussion.

[Register for the colloquium](https://ecofast2027.sciencesconf.org).

## Speakers

Miguel Berdugo, Alejandro Viloria Cano, Stephan Munch, Mathieu Pélissié, Benoît Pichon,
Francesco Pomati, Juan Rocha, Serguei Saavedra, Martina Sánchez-Pinillos, Camilla Sguotti

Further speakers will be announced.
